subject: Apex demo scheduling and prep — request to shift
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@apex-analytics.com>, procurement@apex-analytics.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-07-29T15:02:00-04:00
Subject: Apex demo — proposed time and prep request

Hi Sarah / Apex team,

Thanks for the interest — excited to walk you through Redwood. We can do a live demo the week of Aug 3. I wanted to ask for a short scheduling tweak: our solutions engineer (Monica) needs 48–72 hours to onboard the sample prompts and workload traces you mentioned so the demo uses your data patterns (this changes the narrative and helps us show the right latency/cost tradeoffs).

Proposed windows (ET):
- Tue Aug 4, 11:00–11:45
- Thu Aug 6, 10:00–10:45

If those don't work, we can slide to Mon Aug 10 / Tue Aug 11.

Prep items we'd need (high level):
- short prompt set (CSV) with ~10 example prompts (anonymized)
- a small sample of workload traces (JSONL) showing sequence lengths and request rates
- example embedding/rerank inputs if you want those covered
- an account/role or temporary S3 link for sample data (or a sanitized Drive folder)
- signed NDA (attached) if you prefer the data under NDA

Could you confirm which of the above you can share and any timeline constraints from procurement? If we need to move the demo 3–4 days later to give Monica time to prepare, that's fine on our side.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference
(415) 555-0127

Ben — thanks for the clear list. We can definitely provide an anonymized prompt set and a small trace sample. I attached the quick checklist internally. One wrinkle: several folks who must attend are traveling the week of Aug 3 and won't be back until Aug 9. Procurement asked that we get any commercial terms started by Aug 12.

Would Mon Aug 10 or Tue Aug 11 work for you? If you can do Aug 11 later in the morning ET that would be ideal for our team. We'll upload the sanitized prompt CSV and traces by end of week (I'll confirm once uploaded).

—Sarah

Thanks Sarah — Aug 11 works. Let's tentatively set Tue Aug 11 at 11:00–11:45 AM ET. Monica (cc'd) will own the hands-on part and will need the files you mentioned by EOD Fri (Aug 6) to run a dry run and configure a sandbox with your request patterns.

Checklist for the dry run (Monica's team):
- sanitized_prompt_set.csv (10–15 rows)
- workload_traces.jsonl (at least 200 request records, anonymized)
- a short doc with expected success criteria (3–4 bullet items)
- temporary S3 link or Drive folder with sample payloads (read-only)

If procurement needs a statement of work or high-level estimate to start paperwork, I can get a short SOW over this week. I'll create the calendar invite once we confirm attendees.

Monica — can you please confirm we can run the dry run with these items and whether you need additional permissions (IAM role / temporary creds)?

Best,
Ben
